title: release(DEV-05.2): harden candidates and document blocked collector reliability
body:
Saturated collector restart can delete already-checkpointed telemetry before replacement queue entries are committed. This PR keeps the production 0.123.0 pin/guard, preserves the observed delivery failures and bounded replay evidence, and proposes an architecture decision with separate native qualification and enforceable production replay requirements. Neither path is approved for production.

**CHK-001 FAIL · CHK-002 BLOCKED · SECURITY BLOCKED · RELEASE NO-GO. Keep draft.** References #68; historical #65/#67 evidence remains unchanged. No merge, deployment, image publication, waiver or DEV-05.2B transition.

## CHK-001 architecture decision — Proposed / Pending accountable approval

DEV-05.2A.3E is **design/evidence only**, commit `5fc003b8e026eb4a3479c77084ef8ef894417173`. The [ADR](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/blob/5fc003b8e026eb4a3479c77084ef8ef894417173/docs/verification/dev052/security/2026-10-26-adr/ADR-CHK-001.md) applies the user-approved rule: prefer supported native correction only after safe saturated and interrupted recovery is demonstrated; retain independent reconciliation for both paths; permit replay as primary only with enforceable source completeness, retention and missing-ID detection. Neither option currently qualifies.

The [native acceptance plan](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/blob/5fc003b8e026eb4a3479c77084ef8ef894417173/docs/verification/dev052/security/2026-10-26-adr/NATIVE_ACCEPTANCE_PLAN.md) specifies witnessed transaction cuts, saturation and repeated restarts, durability faults, independent authenticated API/PG receipts, duplicate accounting and rollback qualification. The [production replay contract](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/blob/5fc003b8e026eb4a3479c77084ef8ef894417173/docs/verification/dev052/security/2026-10-26-adr/REPLAY_CONTRACT.md) specifies durable capture/inventory, retention/admission enforcement, independent gap detection, fenced idempotent recovery, duplicate/ordering limits and irrecoverable-condition escalation. These are proposed requirements, not implemented or newly passing tests.

Recommended next scope: an owner-approved native recovery feasibility slice for one source/digest-bound candidate, with unchanged267-ID baseline and N1–N4 transaction tests. Unsupported provenance/approval blocks execution; any actual gap is FAIL. No production guard/queue change or custom-binary/transition approval is inferred. Named runtime, source/ingestion, API/data, SRE, verification, security/supply-chain and release roles must supply accountable signoffs and support/retention/duplicate budgets.

Design verification reconciled17 selected historical cases against raw API/DB exports, checked64 referenced files against the evidence commit, verified588 prior artifact hashes and validated document links/scope. **No runtime tests or containers were started for this ADR.** Prior native4PASS/13FAIL and91 regressionPASS remain historical D observations. CHK-001 FAIL, CHK-002 BLOCKED, SECURITY BLOCKED and RELEASE NO-GO remain unchanged.

## Collector reliability evidence (DEV-05.2A.3D)

Implementation: `d48cf540aa1759b770eee6e30d619f939c281f0a`. D evidence commit: `a4886b894aaeb2aa2ed48d3abe1748afe41a05fa`. Product under test: `97be9b3d1acffc83367b79cdc9ee179f8b694c05`.

- Unchanged guarded default-size staggered baseline: **267 expected / 257 persisted / 10 missing / 0 physical duplicates**.
- Root cause: recovery reads and durably deletes in-flight payloads, then separately re-enqueues them. The old queue rejects replacements at capacity. Upstream PR13330 removes that capacity rejection, but the inspected newer source retains the delete-before-replacement crash window.
- The previously pinned experimental .163.2-labelled binary delivers 267/267 on ordinary restart. Two partial-re-enqueue SIGKILL probes each deliver **258/267**, losing nine. Two post-re-enqueue commit SIGKILL probes deliver 267/267. Matching public source-tag provenance and runtime transition remain blocked; no custom binary/fork was built.
- The small offline replay candidate uses a sealed producer inventory, retained JSONL archive and independent PG receipts. It enforces exact legacy binary SHA, scope, retention/bounds, private-file integrity, atomic publication and idempotence. A leading replay marker avoids filelog fingerprint collision. It neither rewrites checkpoints/queues nor increases capacity or expands the CHK-002 utility.
- Three finite recoveries restore **257 → 267 IDs**, each ending with **267 authenticated accepted attempts / 267 physical rows / zero duplicates**, including repeated crashes and injected queue-write ENOSPC. Native failures stay FAIL. This is not a native queue fix, automatic production recovery or exactly-once guarantee.

## Validation and unresolved failures

Selected native matrix: **4 PASS / 13 FAIL** (all 18 attempts: **4 PASS / 14 FAIL**). Transient API outage/retry passes 4/4. Expired retention blocks replay with ten missing IDs; corrupt queue metadata blocks startup with 267 missing; permanent rejection fails 0/4 before and after replay. The initial unmarked replay failure is retained.

**91 historical D regression tests pass** (not rerun for this ADR): 17 new offline replay safety/SIGKILL tests, 17 unchanged checkpoint/security tests, 57 collection/Agent/authorization/worker tests, zero skips. Syntax, formatting and source whitespace checks pass. Six owned labs cleaned up 18 containers, 12 networks, private credentials/TLS and database volumes, with no owned residue or broad cleanup.

Independent API and PG receipts, stable IDs, physical duplicates, native/recovery phase reconstruction, raw syscall/runtime logs, committed queue snapshots, frozen fixture sources and SHA manifests are committed. First instrumentation runs' missing exact source-hash capture is explicitly disclosed; repeated frozen-source runs confirm the results.

## Other changes and independent gates in this PR

Earlier commits provision the checksum-pinned collector for previously skipped tests, harden candidate base images/tooling, retain digest-bound SBOM/scan/license evidence, evaluate experimental collector compatibility, and partially synchronize filelog handoff. Those earlier results do not establish release clearance. The guarded runtime's recorded vulnerabilities, backend/migration findings, license/NOTICE signoff, final approved release-image identities, provider certification and operational/hosted-check gates remain independent blockers; this queue-only change revises none of them.

Prior frozen decisions: [security](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/blob/a4886b894aaeb2aa2ed48d3abe1748afe41a05fa/docs/verification/dev052/security/2026-10-25/SECURITY_DECISION.md), [remediation](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/blob/a4886b894aaeb2aa2ed48d3abe1748afe41a05fa/docs/verification/dev052/security/2026-10-25-remediation/REMEDIATION_DECISION.md), [followup](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/blob/a4886b894aaeb2aa2ed48d3abe1748afe41a05fa/docs/verification/dev052/security/2026-10-25-followup/FOLLOWUP_DECISION.md), [collector compatibility](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/blob/a4886b894aaeb2aa2ed48d3abe1748afe41a05fa/docs/verification/dev052/security/2026-10-25-collector/COLLECTOR_DECISION.md), [checkpoints](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/blob/a4886b894aaeb2aa2ed48d3abe1748afe41a05fa/docs/verification/dev052/security/2026-10-25-checkpoints/CHECKPOINT_DECISION.md), [handoff durability](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/blob/a4886b894aaeb2aa2ed48d3abe1748afe41a05fa/docs/verification/dev052/security/2026-10-25-durability/DURABILITY_DECISION.md).

Accountable runtime/operations engineering review is required for native queue repair, any custom binary/fork or transition, and real-target replay/integration. Approval is not recorded. These are synthetic probes, not genuine-provider certification. No unrelated hosted workflow was manually rerun.
